bc9efb7485.q: Why did Kress pivot from power tools to commercial outdoor power equipment and robotic mowers after its 2017 acquisition?
bc9efb7485.a: When PosiTech purchased Kress in 2017, the brand was an electric power tool manufacturer in Germany dating back to earlier in the last century. PosiTech decided to repurpose Kress into a battery-driven commercial outdoor power equipment and robotic mower brand for the landscape industry, as battery technology had matured enough to deliver commercial-grade performance.

5f145dcda3.q: What critical design issue affects many commercial battery tools across brands, and how do Kress products address it?
5f145dcda3.a: Throttle trigger failures from dust ingress are a common failure point in commercial battery tools that are often implemented as quick solutions rather than well-engineered components. Kress prioritizes thoughtful engineering to make these components dustproof, reducing catastrophic failures that plague other brands and minimizing commercial downtime for contractors.
